rv.q: The plot of this insistently theological work, as rendered in a fine new version by Frank McGuinness, is fiendishly simple while being intellectually provocative. You see how de Molina might have been able to rattle off, so it’s related, more than 300 plays, making him one of the Spanish Golden Age’s most prolific and prominent authors.
Bijan Sheibani's underpowered production proves unequal to the task.
